subject: Air freight quote request to ULN
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to ULN (Ulaanbaatar, MN), including truck collection from our site in 65797 (Wiesbaden), Germany, and transport to the departure airport? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27.

The shipment consists of 8 pieces of spare parts for packaging machines, with a gross weight of 911 kg and a total volume of 3.27 cbm.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR.

Please do not offer Zephyr Steppe Cargo (ZS) for this shipment or for any of our future inquiries.

Best regards
Petra Meyer
Head of Shipping
Meyer Industrietechnik GmbH, Kassel
